history: Phase 10: ambiguous place names (Aurangabad also being a Maharashtra city) must resolve against Bihar corroboration — quarantined alone, accepted with context.

cases.title: Aurangabad civic body polls announced
cases.body: The municipal corporation of Aurangabad announced ward reservations ahead of civic polls. Officials said voter lists will be revised.

cases.title: Aurangabad road project sanctioned
cases.body: The road construction department sanctioned a bypass for Aurangabad town in Bihar. Officials in Patna said land acquisition begins next month.
